about: Golden set for the in-meeting memory of DecisionAgent / ActionAgent (decision_agent@v3, action_agent@v3; polish program). Each case is one short stretch with the meeting's earlier stretches and the cards already raised (label, text, status: open | settled | dismissed). expected.outcome: update (the answer must update the labelled card, keywords on its content), new (a new card that matches the keywords, nothing updated), nothing_new (no new card; at most a silent repeat that reconcile drops), none (nothing at all: the card was dismissed or settled). Labels are the maintainer's judgement, written before any model was run.
